notes.title: 1.1.0 - Content Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 1.1.0 is out now.

It's a major update that brings a new map with other improvements to enhance gameplay.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] new map with randomly generated content
[*] adjusted easy and normal bot difficulty to more playable level
[*] faster aiming with boomerang and grenade
[*] fixed ESC button in player lobby
[*] German language added
[*] fixed team lobby translation[/list]

Thanks for your support and feedback!
[i]Max[/i]
